title: Fare and Ticket Type Applicability Matrix for Crestline Seat and Bag Subscriptions
content:
Whether the benefits of a Crestline Seat and Bag Subscriptions product apply on a given ticket depends, among other things, on the kind of ticket and flight. The matrix below shows, per subscription, whether benefits apply on Crestline Basic Economy tickets, Summit award tickets, partner-operated flights, companion-certificate tickets and group fares of ten or more passengers.

| Subscription | Crestline Basic Economy tickets | Summit award tickets | Partner-operated flights | Companion-certificate tickets | Group fares of ten or more passengers |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Crestline Bag Pass One | Applies | Applies | Does not apply | Applies | Does not apply |
| Crestline Bag Pass Two | Applies | Applies | Does not apply | Applies | Does not apply |
| Crestline Seat Pass Domestic | Does not apply | Applies | Does not apply | Applies | Does not apply |
| Crestline Seat Pass Network | Does not apply | Applies | Does not apply | Applies | Does not apply |
| Crestline Seat and Bag Pass Domestic | Does not apply | Applies | Does not apply | Applies | Does not apply |
| Crestline Seat and Bag Pass Network | Does not apply | Applies | Does not apply | Applies | Does not apply |

## The matrix read by ticket type

- **Crestline Basic Economy.** Benefits apply for the two Bag Passes only; they do not apply for either Seat Pass or either Seat and Bag Pass.
- **Summit award tickets.** Benefits apply for all six subscriptions.
- **Partner-operated flights.** Benefits apply for none of the six subscriptions.
- **Companion-certificate tickets.** Benefits apply for all six subscriptions.
- **Group fares of ten or more passengers.** Benefits apply for none of the six subscriptions.
